content.name: Lifedrinker
entries: When you hit a creature with your pact weapon, the creature takes extra necrotic damage equal to your Charisma modifier (minimum of 1).

content.name: Lifedrinker
entries: Once per turn when you hit a creature with your pact weapon, you can deal an extra {@damage 1d6} Necrotic, Psychic, or Radiant damage (your choice) to the creature, and you can expend one of your {@variantrule Hit Point Dice|SRD52} to roll it and regain a number of {@variantrule Hit Points|SRD52} equal to the roll plus your Constitution modifier (minimum of 1 {@variantrule Hit Points|SRD52|Hit Point}).
